SSS21.name: 年轮鲷
SSS21.form: a deep oval laterally compressed body with a steep forehead, a large blunt head, a small mouth, ctenoid scales, a complete lateral line, a narrow caudal peduncle
SSS21.fins: a single long dorsal fin with low spines, a slightly forked tail fin, long pointed pectoral fins
SSS21.markings: a series of concentric rings spreading from the flank, a spot at the base of the tail

SSS22.name: 未时鰕虎
SSS22.form: an elongated cylindrical body with a slightly depressed head, a broad blunt snout, a large terminal mouth, the eyes set high and close together, cycloid scales, no lateral line, a slender caudal peduncle
SSS22.fins: two separate dorsal fins, the first with thin spines, a rounded tail fin, broad rounded pectoral fins
SSS22.markings: a row of small square blocks along the upper flank

SSS23.name: 星轨鳗
SSS23.form: a slender ribbon-like body of rounded cross-section, a small pointed head, a short tapered snout, a small terminal mouth, minute embedded scales, a row of subtle luminous pores along the flank
SSS23.fins: a low continuous dorsal fin fusing with the tail fin, no pectoral fins
SSS23.markings: a line of evenly spaced luminous points along the flank

SSS24.name: 虚空鲽
SSS24.form: a deep oval laterally compressed body with a low head, both eyes set close together near the upper edge, a small mouth, a curved lateral line, a short caudal peduncle
SSS24.fins: a long dorsal fin running the full length of the body, a matching long anal fin, a rounded tail fin
SSS24.markings: a scattering of sparse luminous points across the upper surface

SSS25.name: 昨日鲹
SSS25.form: a fusiform body with a rounded belly, a pointed conical head, a small terminal mouth, cycloid scales, a slightly curved lateral line, a narrow compressed caudal peduncle
SSS25.fins: a long dorsal fin with a low anterior lobe, a deeply forked tail fin, long sickle-shaped pectoral fins
SSS25.markings: a row of small scutes along the caudal peduncle, a faint diagonal stripe on the upper flank

SSS26.name: 远景鲳
SSS26.form: a deep oval laterally compressed body with smooth bevelled edges, a small blunt head, a short snout, a small terminal mouth, a slender compressed caudal peduncle
SSS26.fins: a long dorsal fin, a matching long anal fin, a deeply forked tail fin, long slender pectoral fins
SSS26.markings: a single thin vertical band crossing the flank

SSS27.name: 回响鲻
SSS27.form: an elongated cylindrical body with a slightly flattened back, a small conical head, a short blunt snout, a small inferior mouth, cycloid scales, a faint incomplete lateral line, a slender caudal peduncle
SSS27.fins: two separate short dorsal fins, a forked tail fin, pointed pectoral fins set high on the flank
SSS27.markings: a row of faint longitudinal lines along the flank

SSS28.name: 初光鲻
SSS28.form: an elongated cylindrical body with a slightly flattened back, a small conical head, a short blunt snout, a small inferior mouth, cycloid scales, a faint incomplete lateral line, a slender caudal peduncle
SSS28.fins: two separate short dorsal fins, a forked tail fin, pointed pectoral fins set high on the flank
SSS28.markings: a row of faint luminous points along the upper flank

SSS29.name: 遗迹鳐
SSS29.form: a flat diamond-shaped disc with a gently scalloped wing margin, a short blunt snout, a pair of small eyes set close together, a slender whip-like tail
SSS29.fins: large wing-like pectoral fins fused to the head, a low ridge running along the tail
SSS29.markings: eroded angular patches scattered across the disc

SSS30.name: 尘光水母
SSS30.form: a smooth hemispherical bell of translucent glass-like membrane, a gently scalloped bell margin, tentacles arranged in two distinct even rows, a short central stalk
SSS30.markings: a ring of sparse luminous points around the bell margin
